updateNotes: V2-tv Beta, third update. Formuler remotes get their own layout (Settings > Player > Remote Control: Automatic, Android TV or Formuler): Guide, Info, CH+/CH-, Last channel, number keys, long Back for recent channels, and colour buttons that do something useful on each screen. The Live TV guide now stops at the current half hour and the highlight moves on by itself, the channel list is narrower so programmes get more room, the now marker is a thick red line, the Catch-up label shows the days that can really be replayed, and a new box suggests channels you usually watch around now (learned on your own device only). Channels start faster and flicking through channels is smoother, coming back from full screen keeps the channel playing in the preview, Back closes the channel list at once, the now/next times while watching are correct, and search understands accents and non-English letters.
